g.text: The customer asks for a refund from the order page.
Support checks the order age, the item state and the reason.
The request is inside the policy.
Finance refunds the original payment method.
The customer gets the confirmation email.
The customer asks for a refund.
The request is outside the policy. The customer gets the reason.
